title: Director-General Submission of Inquiries or Investigations

content.scenario: The Director-General in India conducts inquiries or investigations and must submit them to the Central Authority in a specified form, manner, and time.
content.outcome: The Director-General submits the inquiries or investigations to the Central Authority in the required form, manner, and time, as specified by regulations.

user_queries: What is the role of the Director-General in India?
How does the Director-General submit inquiries or investigations?
What are the regulations for submitting inquiries or investigations in India?
